span.span: Informal specification (natural language) sIs_{I} for Codeforces 1197-D

You are given an array a1,a2,…,ana_{1},a_{2},\dots,a_{n} and two integers mm and kk. You can choose some subarray al,al+1,…,ar−1,ara_{l},a_{l+1},\dots,a_{r-1},a_{r}. The cost of subarray al,al+1,…,ar−1,ara_{l},a_{l+1},\dots,a_{r-1},a_{r} is equal to ∑i=lrai−k⁡⌈r−l+1m⌉\sum\limits_{i=l}^{r}a_{i}-k\left\lceil\frac{r-l+1}{m}\right\rceil, where ⌈x⌉\left\lceil x\right\rceil is the least integer greater than or equal to xx. The cost of empty subarray is equal to zero.
For example, if m=3m=3, k=10k=10 and a=[2,−4,15,−3,4,8,3]a=[2,-4,15,-3,4,8,3], then the cost of some subarrays are:
Your task is to find the maximum cost of some subarray (possibly empty) of array aa.

Input. The first line contains three integers nn, mm, and kk (1≤n≤3⋅105,1≤m≤10,1≤k≤1091\leq n\leq 3\cdot 10^{5},1\leq m\leq 10,1\leq k\leq 10^{9}). The second line contains nn integers a1,a2,…,ana_{1},a_{2},\dots,a_{n} (−109≤ai≤109-10^{9}\leq a_{i}\leq 10^{9}).
Output. Print the maximum cost of some subarray of array aa.
